items.title: Josh Jacobs: Does individual work, but iffy for Week 12
items.text:
Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said that Jacobs (finger) did some individual work Saturday, but the running back will "have to show a lot of progress" over the next two days to be available Week 12 versus the Rams, Weston Hodkiewicz of the team's official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
